ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across ~90% of visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottled patch at the far-left distal extremity; smaller diffuse white patch at the far-right distal extremity; high-frequency white speckling concentrated along the inferior margin near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midpoints.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with approximately 10-12 distinct peaks; left lobe exhibits higher-amplitude jagged serrations compared to the more rounded peaks on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature along the superior boundary tapering to rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast rings (dark center with white perimeter) on the mid-left lobe; one similar circular ring on the right lobe adjacent to the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal white linear disruption on the left lobe; multiple vertical linear streaks along the inferior central base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring consistent with previous barnacle attachment sites and linear rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white speckling/mottling pattern localized at the lower central fluke margin near the water surface interface.
